label: Shopping
tooltip: Automatic currency shopping at the Expedition Antiquarian.

enable_auto_shop.label: Enable auto shopping
enable_auto_shop.tooltip: Travel to the Expedition Antiquarian and buy configured items when a currency threshold is met. Only starts out of combat while no other mode owns movement.

targets.label: Shopping targets
targets.tooltip: Items to buy from the Antiquarian. Evaluated Keep → Buy → Keep Buying, lower priority first.
targets.empty_catalog: No supported shopping catalog items are defined.
targets.none: No shopping items configured for this territory.
targets.priority_tooltip: Order matters — items at the top get bought first. Items process Keep targets first, then Buy targets, then Keep Buying. Only one item can have Keep Buying at a time.
